rationale: Pete approved these four crop production gap classes and limitations on 2026-11-25: Very little 0-20%; Low >20-40%; Medium >40-60%; High >60-100% of attainable yield. FAO SOLAW 2025 Figure 19 supplies five bands; RuralScan relabels, merges the top two and uses upper-inclusive endpoints. Annex 1.2 uses high-input GAEZ v5 attainable yields and FAOSTAT country yields, distinct from the pixel yield-achievement product. Initial demonstration covers maize/rice/wheat, 2001-2020; other crops and spatial transfer require contextual review. Not livestock, pasture NPP or mixed-system classes. Missing observations or nonpositive attainable yields remain unknown; negative gaps retain raw values for review, not clipping. Non-cropped land is outside the measure. Gap is baseline need, not NbS-closable benefit. Dataset selection and runtime release remain outstanding. See priority/supplementary/2026-11-25-production-gap-classes.md.
